mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters, or if the correlation between GDP decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.2% and PAYEMS increase > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts coupled with a decrease in the real personal savings rate signals a strong demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and investment increase.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and RSAFS decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST increase and RSAFS decrease on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investor confidence increases.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between low inflation and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a supply shock, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as production bottlenecks and cost increases impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decrease and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
